summary: Frontend regression + new-features testing for Team Matrix view, Distributor ID Card, and offline QR codes. All new features work end-to-end. Console shows benign html-to-image SecurityError warnings when inlining Google Fonts CSS during PNG generation (does not break the download flow, just skips font inlining).
critical_code_review_comments: IdCard.js: html-to-image tries to inline remote Google Fonts CSS and logs a SecurityError to console (harmless but noisy). Consider passing `skipFonts: true` or `fontEmbedCSS: ''` to toPng to silence the warning and speed up render.
IdCard.js download flow silently degrades if toPng fails; the toast covers that case, no change needed.

Team.js MatrixView horizontal connector line uses `left-0 right-0` on the container but is drawn only when members>1; visually correct for 3 nodes; edge case with 1 child would still look fine because the line is hidden.
